message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc serves technology innovators as a mission-critical design enablement partner for complex engineering challenges across end markets including AI infrastructure, communications, industrial automation, aerospace and defense, automotive, semiconductor, and general electronics [D1]. The company sells design, emulation, and test solutions that connect market-leading capabilities across the full lifecycle to help engineering teams accelerate innovation and bring new technologies to market faster [D1]. Customers rely on Keysight to bridge virtual design and physical reality, enabling confident decisions earlier in their development processes [D1].
